name: gh-pulse
description: Watch PR checks and GitHub Actions release pipelines from inside Claude Code

claudeContext.title: Tell Claude your CI status
claudeContext.description: Attach a one-line CI summary to your prompts while anything is tracked

confetti.title: Merge confetti
confetti.description: A burst of pixel confetti when a tracked PR merges

invaders.title: Space invaders for Actions
invaders.description: Each Actions job is an invader: passing jobs get shot down, a failing one lands

avatars.title: Reviewer avatars
avatars.description: Show reviewers' GitHub avatars next to the review status

heatmap.title: CI history
heatmap.description: Pass/fail history of each workflow on the base branch

sounds.title: Sounds
sounds.description: A chime when checks pass, a thud when they fail (macOS)

speech.title: Spoken announcements
speech.description: Say transitions out loud, e.g. "PR 131 is green"
